label: Acellular replicators
text: BI.O.A2.5 Acellular replicators. Viruses, viroids and similar replicators reproduce only inside a host cell. The Baltimore scheme classifies viruses into seven classes by genome type and route to mRNA. Quasispecies theory describes mutant swarms under high mutation rate; its fit to real viral populations is CONTESTED. Virology as a named group is in the catalog register (BI.B.K).

warrant.standard: Isolation and sequencing; replication in host cells
